name: MathlibAnnex.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.NonUnitalCStarRepresentation.faithful_and_compactOperatorModel_of_singleton
title: A singleton model is faithful and exactly compact-valued

content.display_title: A singleton model is faithful and exactly compact-valued
content.one_sentence_role: Combines faithfulness with both inclusions needed to identify the represented range.
content.natural_language_statement: Let $A$ be a nonzero complex $C^*$-algebra, with no unit assumed, and let $\pi:A\to\mathcal B(H)$ represent the unique unitary-equivalence class of nonzero irreducible $*$-representations on a separable complex Hilbert space $H$. Then $$\ker\pi=\{0\},\qquad \pi(A)=\mathcal K(H).$$ Equivalently, $\pi$ is a faithful $*$-representation and implements a $*$-isomorphism $A\cong_*\mathcal K(H)$.
content.assumptions: There is no assumption that $A$ is separable, simple, or already faithfully represented. The singleton condition quantifies over nonzero irreducible comparison representations, without restricting them to separable spaces.
content.conclusion: $\pi$ is injective and satisfies the compact-operator model predicate: every $\pi(a)$ is compact and each compact operator has a preimage in $A$.
content.proof_summary: Apply the three established results to the same singleton representation and assemble their outputs.
proof_steps: Apply [Faithfulness of a singleton representation](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/NonUnital/Singleton.lean#L33-L94) to $A$ and the given singleton $\pi$. Nontriviality and the usual $C^*$-algebra order are among the present assumptions; no separability is needed in that step. Its output is injectivity of this $\pi$.

Apply [Every represented operator is compact](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/NonUnital/CompactExclusion.lean#L68-L182) to the same $A,H,\pi$. Its additional hypothesis is precisely the assumed separability of $H$. For every $a\in A$ it gives compactness of $\pi(a)$, hence $\pi(A)\subseteq\mathcal K(H)$.

For any compact $T:H\to H$, apply [Every compact operator has a preimage](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/NonUnital/CompactRange.lean#L211-L222) using these same assumptions and that particular $T$. The result is $a\in A$ with $\pi(a)=T$, hence $\mathcal K(H)\subseteq\pi(A)$. Substituting all three outputs into [The three clauses of a compact-operator model](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CompactModel.lean#L26-L33) proves the model property, alongside the explicitly stated injectivity.
